source: Live receipt captured from an anvil fork of Base mainnet (chainId 8453, fork block 51599514, mainnet.base.org, 2026-09-21) during this package's Base fork lane (test/fork/base.fork.test.ts, 'the wNFT round trip'). Seller is anvil's own default account #0 (well-known Foundry/Hardhat test key) — never a real wallet. Router/wrapper/quoteToken/pair addresses are the SAME real deployed Base mainnet contracts the fork forked from. Transaction: swapExactTokensForETH(3755980581186721 wrapper units, amountOutMin, [WDEMON, WETH], seller, deadline) — a PLAIN fungible AMM swap (no *Collection function, no marketplace fee, no royalty): a swapExactTokensForETH-style leg with no royalty/fee split, on a WERC721 wrapper token rather than the underlying collection.
note: This is a REAL, mined transaction (sent to the anvil fork, not fabricated). ORIGINAL FINDING (not fixed at the time): parseReceipt(ctx, receipt) could not attribute `received` (or `paid`) for a pure wNFT/fungible sale AT ALL — its settlement-direction branches in parseReceipt.ts keyed off `itemsIn`/`itemsOut` (ERC-721 Transfer-log counts, i.e. WHOLE-NFT legs), which are always empty for a fungible-only wrapper-token transfer (the wrapper's own Transfer log is ERC-20-shaped: 2 indexed args + a non-indexed `value`, which does not match the 3-indexed-arg ERC-721 Transfer signature parseTransfers decodes for). Later FIXED: parseReceipt now ALSO detects a fungible leg generically from the receipt's own pair Swap log (an ERC-20 Transfer into the pair from a non-zero address = a fungible sell leg), so `received` now populates from the SAME WETH Withdrawal log that always proved the seller received real ETH (480375864051 wei). `test/receipt/parseReceipt.test.ts`'s real assertion asserts the FIXED, current behavior: itemsIn/itemsOut both empty (still — no ERC-721 Transfer logs in a fungible-only leg, by design), `received` now populated (480375864051 wei), `paid` undefined, fees.marketplace/royalty both 0, and a warnings entry disclosing both the marketplace-fee gap and the royalty gap.

expected.note: See this file's top-level 'note' field for the fix history (Finding 3) — verified directly against parseReceipt(ctx, receipt) in test/receipt/parseReceipt.test.ts, not assumed. received === grossWithdrawnWei exactly (marketplaceFeeWei is 0 for this plain fungible leg, no *Collection call).
